title: The Last Vector Again
author: Xanthe Vane
blurb: Mara Reyes, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
